facts.text: "I wanted a quiet dinner. The mask had other plans, and now the whole room is dancing."
facts.why: Stanley never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Stanley Ipkiss, so it reads as a film line. The famous lines belong to the Mask himself.
facts.fix: Ooh, somebody stop me! (sign it The Mask)

vibe.verdict: The Coco Bongo club is right, but the black and gold look is too polite for a film that is all yellow and green chaos.
missing: Cuban Pete dance with the cops (the park and the station)
The yellow zoot suit and spinning like a tornado (the Mask)
Hold on, Sugar! Daddy's got a sweet tooth tonight (the Mask at the bank)
Balloon animals for the cops (the Mask and the police)
ideas: Swap 'Coco Bongo cocktail' for 'Smokin' cigar-shaped churro' with a zoot suit gag.
Swap the made up Stanley note for a real Mask line.
Swap 'Stanley's Edge City smash burger' for 'Edge City Bank lunch, in a cartoon cheque'.
Recolour the page with yellow and green on black instead of black and gold.
